visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot of a golden Pokemon card titled 'Team Rocket's Glory' is held by a hand against a blurred indoor background. The card features Mewtwo and Giovanni. Red and yellow text overlays appear. (2) The scene shifts to two young boys sitting at a white dining table covered with numerous Pokemon cards. The boy on the left wears glasses and a pink shirt, while the boy on the right wears a black shirt. They are excited, gesturing towards the cards. (3) A sequence of close-ups shows different Pokemon cards including Meowth, Persian, and Moltres, each in protective sleeves. The boys' hands are seen interacting with the cards. (4) The boy with glasses holds a specific card and looks at the camera with an excited expression. The background shows a modern living room with a large Mickey Mouse themed artwork. (5) A toddler girl in a yellow dress sits on the floor nearby, holding a Voltorb card and smiling at the camera. Hands reach in to show her more cards. (6) The video concludes with the boy holding up a variety of rare-looking cards toward the lens, smiling broadly while the other boy makes a peace sign in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy synthesized BGM with a strong electronic beat begins. An adult female voice exclaims enthusiastically about a 'lucky pull.' (2) The sound of rustling cards and plastic sleeves is clearly audible as children cheer. A 'Ding' sound effect emphasizes the appearance of the first rare card. (3) One boy thanks his mother with a rapid, excited speech rate and high pitch. The BGM remains steady and upbeat. (4) A chorus of 'Wow' and laughter from multiple children overlaps with the music. A bubble-like pop SFX triggers as cards are flipped. (5) The toddler girl's babbling is heard faintly in the background between louder exclamations from the older boys. (6) Final energetic cheers and card rustling conclude the clip as the music fades out with a hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the excitement and joy of children unboxing rare Pokemon cards, specifically the 'Team Rocket' collection, while highlighting the family bond and the thrill of the 'gold card' pull.
